title: From "Weak" Signals to Strong Models: Preference Delta Aggregation with LoRA Merging
abstract: arXiv:2606.00357v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Training strong large language models (LLMs) requires high-quality supervision, which is often scarce. Recent work shows that paired preference data from weak-weaker model pairs (e.g., Qwen3 4B over 1.7B), despite the limited quality of individual responses, can provide an effective supervision signal through relative quality deltas, which we term a "weak" signal. This motivates a key research question: can multiple "weak" signals be constructively aggregated for improving strong models (e.g., Qwen3 8B)? To this end, we propose Preference Delta Aggregation (PDA), the first framework that derives a preference delta from each weak-weaker model pair, instantiates it as a LoRA adapter learned through preference optimization, and aggregates the resulting deltas via LoRA merging. translated_title: 从“弱”信号到强模型：基于LoRA合并的偏好增量聚合
translated_abstract: 训练强大的大语言模型（LLM）需要高质量的监督信号，而这种信号通常稀缺。近期研究表明，来自弱-更弱模型对（如Qwen3 4B优于1.7B）的成对偏好数据，尽管单个回答的质量有限，但可以通过相对质量差异提供有效的监督信号，我们将其称为“弱”信号。这引出了一个关键研究问题：能否将多个“弱”信号进行建设性的聚合，以改进强模型（如Qwen3 8B）？为此，我们提出了偏好增量聚合（PDA），这是首个从每个弱-更弱模型对中提取偏好增量、将其实例化为通过偏好优化学习到的LoRA适配器、并通过LoRA合并聚合所得增量的框架。为了改进独立训练的适配器之间的组合效果，我们引入了几何对齐合并（GAM），该方法对齐各适配器的左右奇异基……
tldr: 提出了偏好增量聚合（PDA）框架，将多个弱-更弱模型对产生的“弱”偏好信号分别学习为LoRA适配器，并通过几何对齐合并（GAM）进行聚合，从而有效提升强模型（如Qwen3 8B）的性能。
